verdict.rationale: Mastra provides workflow primitives like `.parallel()` for simultaneous step execution and background/async tool dispatch that could be used to build bulk-processing pipelines, but there is no dedicated 'bulk operation' feature, batch API, or documentation describing operating over many items at once as a first-class capability. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API or UI for operating on many items simultaneously, documented examples of bulk item processing, independent evidence of this pattern being used in practice.
